serviceUnavailable.title: We can't reach your inventory right now
serviceUnavailable.message:
There's a problem connecting to your database. You can check the status of your supabase db on vercel.com -> storage -> .
Common causes:
1. You got banned from supabase for using an unserious email during vercel signup.

setup.languageCardHint: Everything from here on will be in this language.
setup.passwordCardHint: This is the only key to your itemlogs. If you lose it, you lose access to your account for good — there's no recovery. You'll also need this password if you ever want to change it later.
setup.barcodeCardHint: Adds a barcode field to your items, so you can scan instead of typing when logging or looking things up. You can change this later in Settings.
setup.sellPriceCardTitle: Do you need a sell price?
setup.sellPriceCardHint: Turns on the Sales feature: group items into a sale, mark them as sold, and itemlogs tracks your profit automatically (sell price minus cost price). Skip this if you're just cataloging what you own rather than selling it. You can change this later in Settings.
setup.packageFeesCardTitle: Do you need package fee distribution?
setup.packageFeesCardHint: For shipments from abroad: convert currencies and split a package's tariff and shipping fee across every item inside it with one click, updating each item's cost price for you. Without this, Packages still work fine — they're just another way to group and categorize your items. You can change this later in Settings.
setup.currencyCardHint: Used for your purchase and sell prices by default. You can change this later in Settings.
setup.genericError: Something went wrong. Please try again.
setup.finishingHint: Your database is still warming up after being created — this usually takes a few seconds, occasionally up to a minute. Hang tight, we'll take you in as soon as it's ready.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
flavourTexts: Itemlogs can auto-calculate cost prices. Settings FUNCTIONALITY -> Use package fees!
Itemlogs is free and hosted on the cloud. How can that be? By you only having 1GB space for images. But don't worry. We compress your images heavily!
Like the app? Support the dev! Buy a theme!
You can feature items on your visitor page. Feature up to 5 items at a time.
You can create blueprints for your items. Create a blueprint from an item, then create a new item from that blueprint. Saves time!
Got a spreadsheet of inventory already? Import Excel from the Items page!
You can create shareable passwords for staff or collaborators in settings.

items.title: Items
items.importHint: Import expects the same columns as Export Excel. Rows with an id update that item; rows with a blank id create a new one. Unknown categories and types are created automatically, and image URLs are fetched and stored for you. If any row has a problem, the whole file is rejected and nothing is imported.

generalSettings.title: General Settings
generalSettings.sellPriceCurrencyHint: Currency for every item's sell price and cost price, shown on your visitor page. Applies shop-wide — not set per item.
generalSettings.defaultPurchasePriceCurrencyHint: Suggested currency when adding an item's purchase price. Each item can still be given its own.
generalSettings.useSellPriceHint: Adds a sell price field to items and turns on Sales: group items into a sale, mark them sold, and track profit (sell price minus cost price) automatically.
generalSettings.useBarcodeHint: Adds a barcode field to items so you can scan instead of typing when logging or looking things up.
generalSettings.usePackageFeesHint: Adds tariff and shipping fee fields to packages, so you can split those costs across every item inside with one click.
generalSettings.useSecretNotesHint: Adds a private notes field on the item's edit page, visible only to you — never shown to visitors.
generalSettings.displayProfitHint: Show profit (sell price minus cost price) on each item card on your Items page.
